text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Congratulations! Cheers! Kampai!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
First off, I wanna thank every one of y'all
for
comin'! And I wanna dedicate this
honor to my
mom, my dad, my friends...
and of course...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
The amazing director who offered me
the star
role in his Western!

text_block_list.name: Young Man
text_block_list.text:
What?! Y-you're not talking about me,
are you?!
I'm still just a student! I'm not
an amazing director
or anything...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Passerby
text_block_list.text:
Hold on, what's going on?! Does that
mean Taiki
was in a movie and won some
kind of award?!
Holy cow!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you back there! Y'all are welcome
to come
join the party! We've got all
sorts of fun stuff
planned! ♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Sure it is! First rule of partyin' is the
more the
merrier! Okay, y'all, first up is...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: A barbecue dance!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Let's do a dance to make the meat taste
extra
good! Rare! ♪ Medium! ♪
Well-done! ♪ And a
do-si-do! ♪

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text: Uh, um... do-si-do!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
All right! The next number is... B-18!
Any of y'all
got bingo yet?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Congratulations! Allow me to
present you
with your fabulous prize...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: An autograph from me and the director!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
My autograph?! A-are you sure that
counts as a
prize?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
All right, y'all, this thing's been more fun
than a
barrel of monkeys! Let's finish
things off with a
bang!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Fantastic! Now that's what I call
beautiful!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Thank y'all so much for coming today! I
had a
blast!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I'm really gonna nail this part
when we
start filming!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: What?
choice_data_list: ああ、撮影も頑張って――……え？
うん、撮影も頑張って――……え？
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, good luck with the shoot, toâ... Huh?
Yeah, good luck with the shoot, to—... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
An award? Let's not get ahead of
ourselves!
We've gotta film the movie
first!
choice_data_list: これ、映画で賞を取ったお祝い……だよな？
これ、映画で賞を取ったお祝い……だよね？
choice_data_list_en: This is to celebrate winning that film award... right?
This is to celebrate winning that film award... right?

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
And before that... I need to assemble a
crew!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
You see, I'm trying to put together a film
for a
student film festival. I couldn't
figure out who I
should ask to play the
lead, but then...

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
That's when I saw Taiki running in a big
race. I was
floored by her enthusiasm.
Even under so much
pressure, she
looked so cheerful.

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
At that moment, I knew she'd be perfect
as my
lead, so I offered her the part
right away!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
And she agreed! Before I knew it, she
was already
talking about getting things
moving. I thought
she meant preparing
for filming, but...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Well, I was just so happy! And what's
better than
a party when you're happy?!
choice_data_list: パーティーの準備だった、と……
choice_data_list_en: So it was party preparations, then...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I've got the other stuff in
mind too.
We still need a crew, right?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So we're gonna need scouting parties!
We'll have
one for auditions and another
for scouting
locations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I guess this is Taiki Shuttle's way of
expressing her
excitement at appearing
in the movie...
choice_data_list: まだパーティーをするのか！？
まだパーティーをするの！？
